title: openclaw/openclaw
claim: openclaw/openclaw — Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
why_good: A cross-platform personal AI assistant ('the lobster way') — friendly framing, but the pitch is broad and the differentiation unclear.
value: Consumer assistant is a brutal, low-willingness-to-pay market unless it nails one sticky workflow.
risk: Crowded and undifferentiated; 'personal assistant, any platform' rarely beats incumbents' bundled assistants.

zh.claim: openclaw/openclaw —— 你自己的个人 AI 助手,任意系统、任意平台,龙虾之道。
zh.why_good: 一个跨平台的个人 AI 助手(龙虾之道)——调性友好,但定位很宽、差异不清。
zh.value: 消费级助手是残酷、低付费意愿的市场,除非拿下一个很黏的工作流。
zh.risk: 拥挤且无差异;任意平台的个人助手很难打过大厂捆绑的助手。
